newsitem.title: MEXICO: Youth robbers use chewing gum as tool to loot cars.
newsitem.headline: Youth robbers use chewing gum as tool to loot cars.

text.p: Young robbers in a Mexico City suburb are using chewing gum as their main tool to plunder cars at stoplights.

Dozens of hapless drivers waiting for the lights to turn green in Nezahualcoyotl have been robbed after chewing gum has been stuck to their windows, effectively making them marked cars, TV reports and authorities said.
Young gang members wander around idling cars and mark those with booty inside. At following lights, older members look out for the tell-tale gum sign and carry out smash and grab robberies.
